points.K3: 证书不等于准入，要结合本实验室

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口的门禁刷卡器旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an access card reader at a lab door and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲准入、培训与离岗交接。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 一条路线：培训、考核、准入、复训、交接图标
shots.prompt_en: A path with five icons along it: a classroom, a test paper with a check, an open door, a refresh arrow, and a handover box. No people.
shots.narration: 从进门到离开，每一步都有规矩。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一张空白结业证书，兴冲冲地要推门进实验室
shots.prompt_en: The young male student excitedly holds a blank completion certificate and reaches to push open a lab door.
shots.narration: 阿杰刷完网课，拿到证书就想进门。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 门禁灯亮红，门打不开
shots.prompt_en: The access reader light turns red and the lab door stays locked.
shots.narration: 门禁却没有开。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研笑着走来，拿着本室空白手册
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over smiling, holding the lab's blank manual.
shots.narration: 小研说：网课只是第一步。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods at the camera.
shots.narration: 准入到底要过哪几关？一起看看。

shots.section_title: 先培训考核，再准入
shots.scene: 教室里学生在听课，旁边是试卷和门
shots.prompt_en: Students listen in a classroom; beside them a test paper and a door icon. No faces in detail.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，先接受安全教育。

shots.section_title: 先培训考核，再准入
shots.scene: 签到表被打叉，试卷打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank sign-in sheet crossed out with a red X, and a graded test paper with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 签了到，不等于受了培训。

shots.section_title: 先培训考核，再准入
shots.scene: 阿杰在电脑前答题，屏幕显示绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes an online test at a computer; a green check appears on the blank screen.
shots.narration: 学完要考核，合格才能准入。

shots.section_title: 先培训考核，再准入
shots.scene: 阿杰签安全承诺书，门禁灯变绿
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank commitment form and the access reader light turns green.
shots.narration: 签了安全承诺书，才拿到准入资格。

shots.section_title: 先培训考核，再准入
shots.scene: 实验室里的应急预案和操作规程两本空白册子
shots.prompt_en: Two blank booklets on a shelf in the lab: one with a procedure icon, one with an emergency siren icon. No people.
shots.narration: 既学操作规程，也学应急预案。

shots.section_title: 先培训考核，再准入
shots.scene: 进出登记本和指导教师
shots.prompt_en: A blank entry logbook at the door and the older man guiding students in.
shots.narration: 进出登记，听从指导教师安排。

shots.section_title: 培训分三层：学校、学院、实验室
shots.scene: 三层台阶：学校、学院、实验室，越往下越具体
shots.prompt_en: Three steps going down: a university icon, a department icon, and a lab bench icon, each step showing finer detail. No people.
shots.narration: 培训分三层，一层比一层具体。
overlay: 培训分三层：学校、学院、实验室

shots.section_title: 培训分三层：学校、学院、实验室
shots.scene: 电脑上的学校通识考试
shots.prompt_en: A computer showing a blank online general safety exam with the university emblem shape. No people.
shots.narration: 先过学校的通识培训和考试。

shots.section_title: 培训分三层：学校、学院、实验室
shots.scene: 王老师在学院开专项课：化学、生物等图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a department class with chemistry and biology icons on a blank screen.
shots.narration: 再上学院的专项课程。

shots.section_title: 培训分三层：学校、学院、实验室
shots.scene: 老周在实验台旁讲本课题规程
shots.prompt_en: The older man explains the project's procedures to the young male student at a lab bench.
shots.narration: 最后在实验室，学本岗位规程。

shots.section_title: 证书不等于准入，要结合本实验室
shots.scene: 证书图标旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A blank certificate icon with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有了证书，就能进实验室吗？
overlay: 证书不等于准入，要结合本实验室

shots.section_title: 证书不等于准入，要结合本实验室
shots.scene: 证书加上实操考核和负责人签字才变成钥匙
shots.prompt_en: A certificate plus a hands-on assessment checkmark plus a signature combine into a door key. No people.
shots.narration: 还要本室培训、实操考核，批准后准入。

shots.section_title: 证书不等于准入，要结合本实验室
shots.scene: 通用证书被打叉，本室的柜子和设备高亮
shots.prompt_en: A generic certificate crossed out, while the lab's own cabinets and instruments are highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 通用证书，代替不了现场培训。

shots.section_title: 证书不等于准入，要结合本实验室
shots.scene: 一瓶新试剂放在门外，旁边规程和培训图标还是空的
shots.prompt_en: A new reagent bottle waits outside a cabinet; beside it empty procedure and training icons with question marks. No people.
shots.narration: 规则没定、培训没做，不能用也不能存。

shots.section_title: 培训讲清本岗位的危害和防护
shots.scene: 王老师指着岗位危害告知卡讲解
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank hazard card for a work station while teaching students.
shots.narration: 培训要讲清本岗位有哪些危害。
overlay: 培训讲清本岗位的危害和防护

shots.section_title: 培训讲清本岗位的危害和防护
shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、通风柜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles, gloves and a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 以及自己该采取哪些防护。

shots.section_title: 培训讲清本岗位的危害和防护
shots.scene: 老李在配电箱旁接受培训
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer attends a briefing beside an electrical panel.
shots.narration: 安装维修、在电气设备旁工作，也要培训。

shots.section_title: 培训讲清本岗位的危害和防护
shots.scene: 废液桶和应急箱，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: A waste container and an emergency kit with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 危险废物和应急岗位，有专门培训。

shots.section_title: 培训讲清本岗位的危害和防护
shots.scene: 没培训就上手的小人被打叉，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of an untrained person handling equipment next to a warning triangle, crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 没培训就上手，事故容易找上门。

shots.section_title: 培训要动手、有实效
shots.scene: 电脑刷题的画面被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of someone only clicking through quiz questions on a computer, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只在电脑上做题，远远不够。

shots.section_title: 培训要动手、有实效
shots.scene: 学生们在老师指导下动手练习
shots.prompt_en: Students practice hands-on at benches while the female graduate student guides them.
shots.narration: 好的培训，一定要动手练。

shots.section_title: 培训要动手、有实效
shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问，小研耐心解答
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises a hand to ask; the female graduate student answers patiently.
shots.narration: 不懂就问，问到会为止。

shots.section_title: 培训要动手、有实效
shots.scene: 不同人拿到不同的培训卡片
shots.prompt_en: Different people pictograms each receive a different colored blank training card. No people.
shots.narration: 按对象设计培训，学完要检验效果。

shots.section_title: 跟做、看护下做、考核后独立
shots.scene: 阿杰站在小研身边看她操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands beside the female graduate student watching her demonstrate.
shots.narration: 新人先跟着老手做。
overlay: 跟做、看护下做、考核后独立

shots.section_title: 跟做、看护下做、考核后独立
shots.scene: 阿杰操作，小研在旁看护
shots.prompt_en: The young male student performs the task while the female graduate student watches closely.
shots.narration: 再在老手看护下自己做。

shots.section_title: 跟做、看护下做、考核后独立
shots.scene: 小研指出一步并纠正，阿杰重做
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points out one step and corrects it; the young male student redoes it.
shots.narration: 哪一步不到位，当场纠正再练。

shots.section_title: 跟做、看护下做、考核后独立
shots.scene: 老周在考核表上签字，阿杰独立操作
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank competency form; the young male student then works independently.
shots.narration: 考核通过，才能独立操作。

shots.section_title: 跟做、看护下做、考核后独立
shots.scene: 深夜独自做危险实验的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of one person alone doing a hazardous experiment at night, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 危险操作，不要一个人做。

shots.section_title: 进新实验室的第一天
shots.scene: 阿杰第一次走进实验室，眼花缭乱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student enters a busy lab for the first time, dazzled by bottles and instruments.
shots.narration: 进新实验室第一天，瓶瓶罐罐看花眼。

shots.section_title: 进新实验室的第一天
shots.scene: 【实拍】负责人带新人巡视，镜头依次经过固定好的气瓶和化学品柜（无品牌，人物不露脸）
shots.prompt_en: The older man walks the young male student around the lab, pointing at a secured gas cylinder and a chemical storage cabinet.
shots.narration: 负责人带你转一圈，指出危险的地方。

shots.section_title: 进新实验室的第一天
shots.scene: 【实拍】沿实验室走一遍，依次停在洗眼器、紧急喷淋、灭火器和安全出口前（无人）
shots.prompt_en: A walk-through past an eyewash station, an emergency shower, a fire extinguisher and an emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 安全设备在哪、怎么拿到，走一遍。

shots.section_title: 进新实验室的第一天
shots.scene: 老周和大家约定警报手势和喊话方式
shots.prompt_en: The older man agrees on an alarm signal with lab members, demonstrating a raised-arm gesture.
shots.narration: 出事怎么通知全室，要事先约定。

shots.section_title: 进新实验室的第一天
shots.scene: 阿杰找灯开关的同时看墙上空白规则
shots.prompt_en: The young male student finds the light switch while reading the blank lab rules poster beside it.
shots.narration: 认识灯开关时，也学会这里的规则。

shots.section_title: 入门须知六件事
shots.scene: 六个图标排成两行
shots.prompt_en: Six icons in two rows: a bottle, a binder, goggles, a check on an instrument, a clean bench, and a first aid kit. No people.
shots.narration: 新人入门，记住六件事。

shots.section_title: 入门须知六件事
shots.scene: 【实拍】实验室里存放安全技术说明书和安全手册的文件夹位置特写（无品牌）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a shelf in the lab holding a blank safety data sheet binder and a blank safety manual.
shots.narration: 知道用什么，说明书和手册在哪。

shots.section_title: 入门须知六件事
shots.scene: 阿杰戴好护目镜手套，检查设备
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on goggles and gloves, then checks an instrument before use.
shots.narration: 知道要什么防护，设备先检查。

shots.section_title: 入门须知六件事
shots.scene: 整洁的台面和急救箱
shots.prompt_en: A tidy lab bench next to a first aid kit and an emergency flowchart icon. No people.
shots.narration: 台面整洁，出了事知道怎么应急。

shots.section_title: 入门须知六件事
shots.scene: 阿杰向老周点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods respectfully as the older man gives instructions.
shots.narration: 听负责人的话，守规矩，天天安全。

shots.section_title: 应急技能培训：灭火器与急救
shots.scene: 培训场地，学员排队
shots.prompt_en: Students line up at an outdoor training area with training fire extinguishers.
shots.narration: 可以参加灭火器使用培训。
overlay: 应急技能培训：灭火器与急救

shots.section_title: 应急技能培训：灭火器与急救
shots.scene: 【实拍】在培训场地用训练灭火器演示提、拔、握、压（无品牌，人物不露脸）
shots.prompt_en: In a training yard, a trainee uses a training fire extinguisher: lift, pull the pin, aim the hose, squeeze.
shots.narration: 提、拔、握、压，要亲手练过。

shots.section_title: 应急技能培训：灭火器与急救
shots.scene: 【实拍】在训练模型上做胸外按压的手部特写（训练模型）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands doing chest compressions on a CPR training manikin.
shots.narration: 急救和心肺复苏，也值得学。

shots.section_title: 换实验、用新设备，先补专项培训
shots.scene: 阿杰换了新课题，面前是一台新仪器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches to a new project and faces an unfamiliar new instrument.
shots.narration: 学过一次，不等于什么都会了。
overlay: 换实验、用新设备，先补专项培训

shots.section_title: 换实验、用新设备，先补专项培训
shots.scene: 新课题、新设备、规程改版三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a new project folder, a new instrument, and a procedure sheet with a new version arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 换课题、新设备、规程改版。

shots.section_title: 换实验、用新设备，先补专项培训
shots.scene: 阿杰先上专项培训，再动手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student attends a focused training session before touching the new instrument.
shots.narration: 都要先补专项培训，再上手。

shots.section_title: 久未操作先复训，定期复训演练
shots.scene: 阿杰假期后回到实验室，手生
shots.prompt_en: After a long break the young male student returns to the lab and looks hesitant at the bench.
shots.narration: 很久没操作，手生了。
overlay: 久未操作先复训，定期复训演练

shots.section_title: 久未操作先复训，定期复训演练
shots.scene: 小研陪他复习一遍，确认后才放手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reviews the procedure with him and watches him do it once before stepping back.
shots.narration: 先复训、再确认，然后上手。

shots.section_title: 久未操作先复训，定期复训演练
shots.scene: 日历上定期的复训和演练标记，老周也参加
shots.prompt_en: A calendar with regular refresher and drill marks; the older man also attends a refresher session.
shots.narration: 定期复训演练，老手也不例外。

shots.section_title: 培训要有记录
shots.scene: 空白培训记录表，四栏图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank training record form with four column icons: a topic, a teacher, a test score, and a date. No people.
shots.narration: 每次培训，都要留下记录。

shots.section_title: 培训要有记录
shots.scene: 记录被归进档案柜
shots.prompt_en: Training records are filed into a cabinet folder with the person's blank name tab. No people.
shots.narration: 写清学了什么、谁讲的、考得怎样。

shots.section_title: 培训要有记录
shots.scene: 日历提醒复训到期
shots.prompt_en: A calendar reminder bell rings beside a training record due for renewal. No people.
shots.narration: 到期提醒复训，记录跟着人走。

shots.section_title: 本课程不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 欣欣举着空白教材，旁边是本实验室的空白规程
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank textbook next to the lab's own blank procedure binder.
shots.narration: 这门课只是基础。
overlay: 本课程不能代替本实验室规程

shots.section_title: 本课程不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 教材和规程放上天平，规程那边更重
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with the textbook on one side and the lab procedure binder on the other, the binder side heavier. No people.
shots.narration: 它不能代替本实验室的规程。

shots.section_title: 本课程不能代替本实验室规程
shots.scene: 小研翻开本室规程，指着一页
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens the lab procedure binder and points at a page.
shots.narration: 具体做法，以本实验室规程为准。

shots.section_title: 离开课题组：清点交接、注销权限
shots.scene: 小研穿学位服，在实验室里收拾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a graduation gown tidies up her bench in the lab.
shots.narration: 毕业或离开课题组之前。
overlay: 离开课题组：清点交接、注销权限

shots.section_title: 离开课题组：清点交接、注销权限
shots.scene: 冰箱里的样品管和试剂逐一核对清单
shots.prompt_en: Sample tubes in a freezer and reagent bottles are checked one by one against a blank inventory list.
shots.narration: 样本、试剂，逐一清点交接。

shots.section_title: 离开课题组：清点交接、注销权限
shots.scene: 实验记录本交到老周手里
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands her lab notebooks to the older man.
shots.narration: 实验记录完整移交。

shots.section_title: 离开课题组：清点交接、注销权限
shots.scene: 门禁卡被注销，图标变灰
shots.prompt_en: An access card icon turns gray with a cancel mark at the card reader. No people.
shots.narration: 门禁和仪器权限，及时注销。

shots.section_title: 离开课题组：清点交接、注销权限
shots.scene: 冰箱里一个没有标签的盒子被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An unlabeled abandoned box in a freezer, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不留无人认领的样本和试剂。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 培训、考核、准入路线
shots.prompt_en: The path of classroom, test paper and open door icons.
shots.narration: 先培训考核，再准入，三层逐级学。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 跟做、看护、独立三个小画面
shots.prompt_en: Three small panels: watching, supervised practice, working independently.
shots.narration: 动手练，看护下做，考核后独立。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 复训箭头和交接盒
shots.prompt_en: A refresh arrow icon next to a handover box.
shots.narration: 换实验补训，久未操作复训，离开要交接。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣在门禁旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the access card reader.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲访客与外来人员管理。
